objective: Preallocate deferred EXISTS membership caches from subquery predicate AST shape.

tasks.title: Preallocate deferred subquery membership cache
tasks.result: Deferred subquery filtering now preallocates the EXISTS membership cache map from the number of EXISTS predicates in the expression.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
Added deferred_subquery_cache_capacity to count EXISTS nodes along the deferred subquery evaluation path.
filter_rows_with_subqueries now initializes membership_caches with that capacity hint.
